v25-15.candidate: The Lord’s wrath came upon Amaziah, and He sent him prophets who said, “Why have you sought that people’s gods, who did not rescue their people from your hand?”
v25-15.close: The Lord’s wrath came upon Amaziah, and He sent him prophets who said, “Why have you sought the gods of a people who could not rescue their own people from your hand?”

v25-19.candidate: You said, ‘Behold, you have struck Idumea,’ and your heavy heart lifts you up. Now remain in your house. Why engage in evil, so that you fall, you and Judah with you?”
v25-19.close: You say, ‘Behold, you have struck Idumea,’ and your heavy heart lifts you up. Now remain in your house. Why engage in evil, so that you fall, you and Judah with you?”
